args.summary: Detected checkout-api failing health checks after deployment of v2.3.1 (error rate 0.18 across all production regions: us-east, us-west, eu-west). Rolled back all production regions to the most recent release that was healthy in production, v2.3.0 (v2.3.1-rc was excluded as it was never healthy in production, only staging). Rollback verified in all regions; service is now healthy with error rate reduced to 0.002. Remediation complete; incident opened post-rollback to document the outage and rollback.
args.title: checkout-api outage after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

**Rollback:**
- Identified v2.3.1 (current in all regions) as unhealthy with an 18% error rate.
- Identified **v2.3.0** as the most recent release that was healthy in production — v2.3.1-rc was excluded since it was only ever healthy in staging, not production.
- Rolled back all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) to v2.3.0; execution verified.

**Verification:**
- checkout-api is now healthy across all regions with the error rate down to **0.2%** (from 18%).

**Incident:**
- Opened **SEV2 incident INC-0001** for checkout-api documenting the outage, the rollback decision, and the verified recovery. On-call has been paged.

No change-manager approval was needed since v2.3.0 was previously healthy in production.
